Priya Nair: Auditor emailed requesting reproducible evidence for the emergency KMS rotation tied to CVE-2025-0421. Scope: prod account 123456789012, window 2025-11-27 -> 2025-12-02. Need: CloudTrail KMS events, IAM deprov diffs, key-policy snapshots, approval chain, signed attestation, and a replay script. Can someone own packaging?

Oscar Li: I got the logs. I will run CloudTrail lookup + CloudWatch Logs Insights for kms.amazonaws.com events (EnableKeyRotation, DisableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion, GenerateDataKey, Decrypt). Ill output `cloudtrail/events.json` and an index CSV. Will include exact AWS CLI commands used.

Ben Morales: Ill generate the RBAC diffs from the change-store. CSV fields: chg_id, actor, target, pre_bindings, post_bindings, ticket. I will scrub personal emails and produce a redaction_map.txt that maps redacted -> original for auditor-only reconciliation.

Priya Nair: Include rotation id rot-20251130-22 and ticket INC-9955. Auditor needs proof that the deprovisioned principal fails decrypt after rotation.

Oscar Li: I will run an impersonation check with assume-role for deprov-svc-role and attempt decrypt. Ill capture the CloudTrail AccessDenied event and include raw JSON. Sample CLI Ill use: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventId,AttributeValue=<id>` and `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deprov-svc-role --role-session-name audit-check`.

evidence-bot: snapshot job started (id: ev-1778887777). Target s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1778887777.tar.gz

Auditor - Deloitte: Package must be reproducible. Provide `replay_check.sh` that re-runs the lookups (read-only) and validates bundle sha256. Also need signed attestation (PDF) and the S3 put-object headers proving object-lock/retention.

Ben Morales: Redactions: will redact internal IPs and personal emails; will not redact ARNs or key IDs. Redaction map included in tickets/redactions_map.txt.

Oscar Li: Upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1778887777.tar.gz (object-lock enabled). Manifest at manifests/manifest.json with sha256: c4f9b2... Commands log at scripts/commands.log. Decrypt failure eventId: 5a3d2c7f-0001 at 2025-12-01T06:13:09Z (file cloudtrail/errors/5a3d2c7f.json).

Priya Nair: I will draft a 1-page cover letter, the control matrix mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9, and attach the signed PGP attestation. Will also note any redactions applied.

Auditor - Deloitte: Received. Please confirm approval timestamps for rot-20251130-22 (who signed & when) and include pre/post key-policy snapshots. After that we will schedule a short remote replay to validate `replay_check.sh`.

Priya Nair: Approval metadata: INC-9955 approvals: "Oscar Li (SecOps)" 2025-11-30T01:05:12Z and "Priya Nair (CISO)" 2025-11-30T01:22:49Z. Key policy snapshots in kms_policies/key-policy-before.json and key-policy-after.json. Bundle ready. 

evidence-bot: snapshot job ev-1778887777 completed: 860MB uploaded, manifest signed and placed at s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1778887777/manifest.json.
